# Sample planning note — 5G core registration (unrelated)

Source-id: sample-core-registration
Locator: section-9

This note covers UE registration and authentication with AMF/AUSF. It does not discuss radio BLER, mid-band cells, or antenna tilt.

Use it to verify that an unrelated core-network question does not invent radio citations, and that a radio question does not need this document.
